title: Validate the Git storage publisher on Linux and test it through the real pre-push hook
goal: Run T-DOTGITPUBLISHER-1's pending combined validation (the 26-test local-snapshot suite with the graft-history guard and adjacent push-policy discovery, strict clippy, build, fmt) on the exact combined tree on native Linux x86_64. Add a permanent test that drives the built local-snapshot and push-policy together through the repository's own .githooks/pre-push. Then use the publisher for real to publish to origin/main.
owner: linuxpub (Cursor agent on CachyOS Linux x86_64, CEO laptop)

results.host: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, CachyOS, Rust 1.99.0, Git 2.56.0; isolated HOME/XDG/SUSI_HOME/TMPDIR, real CARGO_HOME/RUSTUP_HOME, private target dir
results.combined_validation_at_fd6739c63: cargo test --offline --locked -p xtask --features release-tooling --bin local-snapshot: 26 passed, 0 failed (test phase 4.02 s, 32.7 s wall with build); cargo clippy -p xtask --features release-tooling --bin local-snapshot --bin push-policy -- -D warnings: exit 0 (12.3 s); cargo fmt --all --check: exit 0 (10.4 s); cold build of local-snapshot, push-policy, local-workflow in a fresh target: 13.9 s

results.hook_test_mutation: With adjacent_helper_path forced to return no helper, 3 of the 4 hook tests fail; restored afterwards.
results.end_to_end_real_executable: Scratch run against a bare copy of the real repository with the real hook: divergent-main submit composed a two-parent merge and verified it remotely in 1.05 s; status-main and retry-main idempotent; publisher without its helper left main unchanged; snapshot cut, status and fresh-clone adopt succeeded; tag replacement and release-branch push refused by the hook.
results.dogfood_publication: local-snapshot submit linuxpub-xtask-build-20261111 published 69e4e958e (T-LINUXPUB-2) to origin/main by ordinary fast-forward in 5.6 s; git ls-remote confirmed it. status-main afterwards: 1.5 s. Process start (usage path): 7-10 ms.
results.guards: core_docs_promise_no_ui_or_plugins 5/5, lean_core_ceilings 2/2, orphan_sources 3/3 passed; architecture_tests 38 passed, 5 failed (all in files owned by mainfix: root AGENTS.md, .githooks/pre-push, README.md, .agents/identity.json, crates/susi-harness/tests/native_link.rs); 85.8 s wall including the susi test build
results.build_timings_not_budget_numbers: Under load average ~30 from other agents' cargo jobs, -j8, nice 19: cargo build -p susi after the guard build 121.8 s (236 units compiled); no-op rebuild 0.69 s; after touching src/main.rs 6.1 s. These are not the 60-second budget figure: neither an idle cold build nor an idle warm build.

limitations: A pre-push hook that declines locally prints no porcelain ref status, so the publisher reports an unknown outcome (pointing to status-main) instead of a confirmed rejection. This is the conservative, fail-closed reading and is left unchanged.

The native gate tool still refuses on Linux (local-workflow list: 'claim worktree must be absolute') because four claim files hold Windows F:/ paths; the publisher does not read claims, so it is unaffected. Not changed here.
xtask/tests/native_push_policy.rs fails strict clippy (option_env_unwrap); owned by mainfix.
No Windows run of the new hook test; no full workspace test run; no release qualification.
provenance: Publisher source by dot (T-DOTGITPUBLISHER-1, last change f92a9c6b5); not modified. Work done in worktree susi-agent-linuxpub on branch local-agent/linuxpub.
